summary: All 6 phases complete. Two ratchet honesty gates landed green on the current tree: scripts/check-axiom-census.sh (exact-set, 43 sorryAx-tainted public Cslib declarations) and scripts/check-sorry-suppressions.sh (per-file two-count ceiling, 18 markers/5 files + 28 sorries/9 files). Wired into .github/workflows/lean_action_ci.yml (suppression gate before the build step, census gate after with if: always()) and scripts/pre-pr-check.sh (steps 8/9), documented in scripts/README.md. Phase 6 proved both regression (exit 1) and improvement (exit 0, ACTION REQUIRED) paths for both gates via .bak/scratch-file mechanics, then restored a bit-identical clean tree. Full 7-step CSLib CI pipeline re-verified green (pre-existing, unrelated debt only). No .lean file under Cslib/ was ever modified.
decisions_made: D1: baseline ledger uses durable anchors (declaration name + owning file path + in-source blocking-reason string), never task numbers. Implemented as written in both baseline files' header comments and per-row/per-comment ledger content. Grep verification across all 8 new/modified files confirmed zero task-number references.

D2: both gates ARE wired into lean_action_ci.yml as scoped -- suppression gate before the (currently-red-by-design) build step, census gate after it with if: always() -- plus additively into pre-pr-check.sh (steps 8/9) and scripts/README.md. Implemented exactly as decided; git diff on the workflow file is purely additive.
D3: improvements print an ACTION REQUIRED re-baseline block naming the exact --update command and exit 0. Implemented in both scripts; verified via scratch-baseline improvement tests for both gates.
D4: no lakefile.toml change -- the census driver runs via `lake env lean --run scripts/AxiomCensus.lean`. Implemented as written; lakefile.toml is untouched.

Axiom-census regression proven by baseline mutation (delete a row), not a scratch tainted declaration, per the plan's own pre-approved Phase 6 Method note. Suppression regression proven literally via a scratch probe file, created and removed within Phase 6.

NEW finding during Phase 1 implementation, not anticipated by the plan or research: literal `Lean.collectAxioms` calls do NOT hit the exportedAxiomsExt cross-declaration cache for a large fraction of this environment's declarations (measured: repeated calls to the SAME declaration cost ~64ms every time, no speedup; a Mathlib-native declaration was also uncached at 213ms, so this is not Cslib-specific). A literal implementation of the plan's specified mechanism was projected at several minutes total -- unacceptable, and contradicting the research's ~2.7s premise for this exact approach on this exact tree. Fix: scripts/AxiomCensus.lean implements collectAxiomsCached, which reproduces Lean.collectAxioms's own dependency-walk semantics exactly but with an explicit shared cache across the whole run. Verified: reproduces tainted=43 exactly, completes in ~8.6s (single process, no per-module spawning -- every other part of the specified design preserved). Fully documented in the script's own header and in the plan's Phase 1 checklist annotation; treated as a transparent, necessary implementation-detail correction rather than a proof-strategy substitution, since scripts/AxiomCensus.lean is tooling (not a Cslib/ proof) and the correctness/performance bar the plan itself set (tainted=43, 'a few seconds, not minutes') was met exactly.
dead_ends: Per-module (one process per .lean file) axiom census: measured by research at ~16-17 minutes. Rejected; not re-explored.

Calling the builtin Lean.collectAxioms directly, per declaration, with no additional caching: this was the plan's literal specified mechanism, but measured (during this implementation) to cost several minutes total on this tree because exportedAxiomsExt's cross-declaration cache is not being hit for a large fraction of declarations here -- see decisions_made above. Superseded by collectAxiomsCached (same semantics, explicit shared cache), which reproduces the identical tainted=43 result in ~8.6s.
Naive `grep -c sorry` for the sorry count: yields 180/168 depending on drift; useless without the full discrimination rule.

Using intuitionisticTableau_complete / minimalTableau_complete as Class-1 silent-taint examples: disproven by research; the genuine witnesses are the `_decides` pair, used exclusively throughout all authored text in this task's deliverables.
Registering the census as a [[lean_exe]] in lakefile.toml: rejected per D4 in favor of `lake env lean --run`.
Following the sibling guards' CI precedent (lint-hygiene.yml / no-CI-at-all): overridden by the orchestrator's D2 in favor of the explicit written scope; not re-proposed.

Running shellcheck locally: not installed in this environment; both new scripts modelled closely on the two existing passing precedents to minimize risk, will be swept by the path-triggered shellcheck.yml CI workflow on push.

Per-line raw \bsorry\b matching for the D1 debt ledger (Phase 3): tested and rejected -- massively overcounts from docstring prose (150 hits vs the true 28), same failure mode the whole task exists to avoid. Ledger extraction instead only harvests a trailing same-line `--` comment on a genuine post-discrimination-rule code-position sorry line; 5 of 9 files legitimately produce no ledger entry because their sorry sites have no trailing comment (blocker context lives in surrounding docstring prose instead, deliberately not parsed).
